trees.title: A warning light has come on
trees.summary: A light has come on the dashboard and it's not clear what it means.
trees.safety: A red light is always an urgent message; an amber light can usually wait for the garage soon. When in doubt, stop in a safe place and check the owner's manual.

n1.q: What colour is the light that has come on?

n2.q: Which symbol does the red light look most like?

options.label: A rectangle with + and −, like a battery
A thermometer, or a wave inside fluid
Round brackets with (!), or the letters BRAKE
A person figure wearing a seatbelt

n3.q: Is the parking brake fully released?

options.label: Yes, released, and the light is still on

n5.q: Which symbol does the amber light look most like?

options.label: The letters ABS, or an exclamation mark (!) inside a round tyre
Another symbol, not identified for sure

n6.q: Is it exactly the letters ABS, or an exclamation mark (!) inside a round tyre?

options.label: An exclamation mark inside a tyre

r-info-light.result: An ordinary information light — not a fault
r-info-light.text: Green and blue lights indicate a system that's active, like [[dash:high-beam]] or [[dash:low-beam]] — not a fault.
actions: No action is needed.
For an exact identification, check the owner's manual for which system each symbol marks.

r-oil.text: [[dash:oil-pressure]] comes on when the pressure in the lubrication system drops below what's required. Without oil pressure, engine parts rub against each other and wear out within minutes.
actions: Stop immediately in a safe place and switch off the engine.
Don't keep driving even if there's oil on the dipstick — call for a tow.

r-battery-dash.result: The charging system isn't charging the battery
r-battery-dash.text: [[dash:battery-charge]] comes on when the alternator isn't charging, usually because of a fault in it or in the belt that drives it. The car is now running on what's left in the battery.
actions: Switch off any electrical loads that aren't essential and drive straight to the nearest garage.
If the engine-temperature light also comes on, stop: the belt that snapped may also drive the water pump.

r-coolant-dash.text: [[dash:coolant-temp]] comes on when the engine is overheating. Continuing to drive can warp the cylinder head and destroy it.
actions: Stop in a safe place and switch off the engine.
Don't open the radiator cap while the engine is hot.
For more detail: [[tree:engine-overheating|the engine is overheating]].

r-parking-brake-dash.text: [[dash:parking-brake]] comes on when the parking brake (a hand brake or an electric one) is applied.
actions: Release the parking brake before driving.
Driving with the brake applied heats up the brakes and wears them.

r-brake-system-dash.result: A fault in the brake system
r-brake-system-dash.text: [[dash:brake-system]] comes on when the parking brake is applied, when the brake fluid level is low, or when there's a fault in the system. If the parking brake is already released, this is a genuine fault.
actions: Stop carefully and check the brake fluid level.
Don't drive with a brake fault.
For more detail: [[tree:brake-problems|a brake problem]].

r-seatbelt-dash.text: [[dash:seatbelt]] comes on when the driver or a passenger hasn't fastened a seatbelt.
actions: Fasten your seatbelt before driving — every passenger, in every seat.

r-check-engine-dash.text: [[dash:check-engine]] comes on when the engine computer detects a fault in the engine or the exhaust system. With a **steady** light you can carry on carefully to the garage. A **flashing** light means a severe ignition fault that can destroy the catalytic converter.
actions: Steady light: go to a garage soon for a computerised diagnosis.
Flashing light: slow down, avoid sharp acceleration, and stop as soon as possible.

r-unknown-amber.text: An unfamiliar amber light usually doesn't need an immediate stop, but it's worth identifying it as quickly as possible — it's listed in the owner's manual, or you can photograph it to show a garage.
actions: Check the owner's manual for the symbol's meaning.
If the light is flashing, or another light joins it, stop and check immediately.
If it stays on steadily with no change in how the car behaves, go to a garage soon.

r-abs-dash.result: A fault in the ABS system
r-abs-dash.text: [[dash:abs]] comes on when ABS isn't active. The ordinary brakes keep working, but under heavy braking the wheels may lock.
actions: Drive carefully and keep a bigger gap.
Go to a garage soon.

r-tpms-dash.text: [[dash:tyre-pressure]] comes on when the tyre-pressure monitoring system detects a tyre with pressure lower than required — or a puncture.
actions: Slow down and check the tyres soon at a petrol station.
Inflate to the pressure set by the car's manufacturer.
If a tyre is deflating quickly, change to the spare wheel.
